name: Valeria Trifa
original_name: ヴァレリア・トリファ
source: Valerian Trifa is a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying the third seat of the Obsedian Round Table. A catholic priest, he acts as Reinhard's representative and as the temporary leader of the LDO.
